exposure: GDM pregnant women with twin versus singleton pregnancies
cohort: 1127 GDM pregnant women (42 with twin pregnancy and 1085 with singleton pregnancy)
finding: In GDM pregnant women, twin pregnancy was associated with an increased prevalence of neonatal morbidity compared to singleton pregnancy, but GDM diagnosis in twin pregnancies was not associated with poorer fetomaternal outcomes compared to non-GDM twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more frequent among GDM women with twin pregnancies compared to those with singleton pregnancies.
